title: Status bars | Apple Developer Documentation - [Best practices](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/status-bars\#Best-practices)
claim: Consider temporarily hiding the status bar when displaying full-screen media.** A status bar can be distracting when people are paying attention to media. Temporarily hide these elements to provide a more immersive experience. The Photos app, for example, hides the status bar and other interface elements when people browse full-screen photos.
